name: Nicole Hardman
source:
Best friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c148365]Kelsey[/url], Nicole Hardman (no relation). Both perpetually tired and perpetually stoned, she gets away with sleeping through all of her classes due to her somehow perfect GPA. While being what is essentially the polar opposite of Kelsey, they are practically inseparable. With one comes the other. In a multitude of ways.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/move-chains-plot-70773805]Patreon[/url]]
